2026_runoff.fact: 'PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION- Republican' (runoffrep.pdf) and '- Democratic' (runoffdem.pdf): scanned one-page county-totals reports headed 'Unofficial Results ... PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION DAY', printed 'Run Time 8:09 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' (Dem: 8:10 PM), with Absentee/Early/Election Day columns (REP US Senator: Paxton 1,853 total, 851 Election Day) but no precinct breakdown. Uploaded later (Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 19:57:01 GMT and 19:54:17 GMT). No precinct-level runoff file is posted on the page, so precinct numbers are never published online. Election-night evidence is the printed run time only.

rationale: Only the runoff is determined: an unofficial county-totals report printed 8:09 PM election night and no precinct numbers posted (LATER). 2024 has no file and the primary has only post-election-night files. One determined election, so COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, low.
